Agent Name: Planner

Step Number: 2

Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a mistake in understanding the genetic cross. The task specifies a pure dominant plant with round seeds crossed with a plant with wrinkled seeds. This indicates a cross between a homozygous dominant plant (RR) and a homozygous recessive plant (rr). The Planner incorrectly assumed the round-seed parent to be heterozygous (Rr), which led to the wrong conclusion that the offspring would be 50% Rr (round) and 50% rr (wrinkled). The correct prediction should be that all offspring will be heterozygous (Rr) and exhibit the round-seed phenotype, since round is dominant over wrinkled.
